contents.text: Added Water Essence (also drinkable), Pure Obsidian, Netherite Nugget, and the Membrane Elytra, all makeable using the crafting table or the furnace/BF. Recipes will be unlocked like vanilla

Added five new late-game Armour sets. There now is a path to the final armour: 
Golden to Netherrack, to Wartrack. 
Iron to Prismarine, to Prismaridian, to Pure Obsidian. 
Golden to Netherrack, to Soul Sand, to Soulite, to Soutralith, to Overlord
Opened the End, which now has temperature and hydration. CAUTION: High weirdness. Only enter with a strong suit
Hydration now ranges slightly over the shown bar, allowing for thirst saturation
Prismarice now has a more fitting sound
Tungsten: Investigated the major performance issue, installed debug features and fixed a few problems already

Fixed Bugs:
Hydration could sometimes be increased without any bound
